name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Reverse-Grip Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench and place the back of one upper arm firmly against the pad while holding a dumbbell with an overhand palm-down grip.
Begin with your arm nearly straight and your shoulder relaxed away from your ear.
Curl the dumbbell upward toward your shoulder while keeping your palm facing downward and your elbow anchored to the pad.
Lower the dumbbell slowly back to the bottom position, and switch sides after completing one arm.
tips: Keep your wrist neutral and avoid curling it upward as the forearm fatigues.
Move with steady control on the descent rather than dropping the weight.
